fields.label: Allocatable Prefix Length
fields.help: The allocatable prefix length supported by this public delegated prefix.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: IP Cidr Range
fields.help: The IP address range, in CIDR format, represented by this public delegated prefix.

fields.label: Is Live Migration
fields.help: If true, the prefix will be live migrated.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: Specifies the mode of this IPv6 PDP.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: A region where the prefix will reside.
